title: A character that follows your cursor
summary: Move the mouse and a cute character on a web page turns its eyes and head to follow it.
brief: A web page with a friendly cartoon character in the middle of the screen. Its eyes follow the mouse pointer and its head turns a little towards it as the pointer moves. Keep the character simple and flat, draw it in code, and ease the turns so the motion feels alive instead of snapping.

assets.excerpt: A frame at 0:02 of the post video

prompts.text: Make a web page with a cute character whose eyes and head follow my mouse cursor. Build it in a new folder inside the current project folder with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, open it in my browser when it is done, and ask me before you install anything.
prompts.label: A cute character that follows the cursor
